ideas.pitch: An edge-AI surveillance system running locally on low-cost hardware to flag industrial safety violations instantly without relying on continuous cloud bandwidth.
ideas.title: EdgeGuard AI: Real-Time PPE & Safety Violation Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with the AI and IoT domains while mirroring a proven hackathon winner by focusing on heavy industrial utility and edge inference.

ideas.pitch: A physical anti-counterfeiting verification device utilizing sensor signatures and microcontroller validation to detect supply chain tampering.
ideas.title: AuraTag: Hardware-Secured Supply Chain Authenticator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges in IoT and hardware tracks love physical, tangible demos over standard web apps, leveraging a proven first-prize architectural blueprint.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous diagnostic and intrusion detection agent tailored for smart home or industrial IoT networks using unsupervised isolation forests.
ideas.title: NetSentry: Localized IoT Network Anomaly & Intrusion Defense
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines cybersecurity and IoT domains seamlessly with automated closed-loop alerting, standing out against basic CRUD apps.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight cryptographic access control tool ensuring edge IoT devices authenticate without exposing raw private keys over local networks.
ideas.title: SecureNode: Zero-Knowledge Credential Guard for Edge Devices
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings rigorous engineering and security primitives into an IoT/Cybersecurity context, satisfying judges looking for deep technical implementation.

ideas.pitch: An air-gapped code review utility that scans repository diffs for security anti-patterns locally without sending proprietary code to external APIs.
ideas.title: LocalAudit: Offline-First Code Vulnerability Scanner for On-Premise Devs
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses critical enterprise cybersecurity needs with a working offline tool that can be live-demonstrated easily in front of judges.
